title: Volcanoes of Peru
intro: 10 volcanoes of Peru, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Yucamane
rounds.fact: Yucamane is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 5,550 m in the source data. The data places it in Peru.
